outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry dot/pseudocolor plots of individual events (cells) with gating, not a bar/summary plot of averages. Each dot represents an individual cell, so the check for overlaying individual points on an average does not apply.

Panel B is a flow cytometry dot plot showing individual cellular events with gating for PC identification; it is not an averaged summary plot, so individual data points are inherently present (each dot = one cell).

Panel C shows flow cytometric gating plots (scatter-type dot plots) of individual cells for NP-binding GC and MBC identification, not a bar chart of means, so it is exempt from requiring additional individual-point overlay.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot of individual cells (MBC, GC, naive populations) showing marker expression; each point is an individual cell, so no additional overlay is needed.

Panel E shows flow cytometry dot plots with gating percentages for MBC subsets; these are scatter-type plots of individual cells, not summary/average plots, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
